lines.zh: 我破开冰下的水，慢慢游。
lines.en: I part the water beneath the ice and swim on.

lines.zh: 冰冷的海水从我背上滑过。
lines.en: Cold seawater slides over my back.
My tusk goes out ahead of me.

lines.zh: 我贴着冰层下面游过去。
lines.en: I travel just beneath the ice sheet.

lines.zh: 我一摆尾，身子就向前滑。
lines.en: One stroke of my tail and I glide forward.

lines.zh: 我从冰缝里浮上来换气。
lines.en: I rise through a gap in the ice to breathe.

lines.zh: 我绕过一根倒下的冰柱。
lines.en: I round a fallen pillar of ice.

lines.zh: 我在冰海的水道里穿行。
lines.en: I thread the channels of the frozen sea.
I swim steadily, unhurried.
I swim toward the school of fish.
My flippers scull gently at my sides.
I pass beneath a stretch of blue ice.
I pass the ice hole without stopping.
I dive and the pressure closes in.

lines.zh: 我从一头冰兽下面穿过。
lines.en: I pass beneath an ice arch.
I swim over the gravel of the sea floor.
I turn slowly out of the bay.
I head for where the ice is thin.

lines.zh: 我头上这根长牙，是螺旋的。
lines.en: The tusk on my head spirals.

lines.zh: 我的长牙斜着指向前方。
lines.en: My tusk points forward at a slant.
My back reflects in the ice above.
The water is clear enough to see far down.

lines.zh: 我听见冰在远处裂了一声。
lines.en: I hear the ice crack somewhere far off.
A few fish circle beneath me.
I settle a little deeper.
There are old scars on my hide.

lines.zh: 我的长牙先探出去，尾巴摆一下。
lines.en: My tusk probes ahead and my tail gives one sweep.

lines.zh: 这里安静得能听见水响。
lines.en: It is quiet enough to hear the water move.
I turn my head to the ice wall.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸在水面留下雾。
lines.en: My breath leaves mist on the water.
I have been here a while.
A ring of thin ice has formed at the hole.
You stand on the ice. I am beneath it.
I rise and my tusk shows first.
From under the ice I can see you.
Do not be afraid. I do not eat people.

lines.zh: 我这根牙，不是用来刺你的。
lines.en: This tusk is not for stabbing you.
If you would feed me, bring fish.
Your boots ring on the ice.
The ice shifts when I come close.

lines.zh: 我在这片海里游了很多年。
lines.en: I have swum this sea for many years.

lines.zh: 冰面上的人影，比鱼大太多。
lines.en: The figure on the ice is far bigger than a fish.
The water is this cold and you stand there.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴一摆，能退很远。
lines.en: One tail stroke takes me far away.
Is that fish in your hand?

lines.zh: 我慢慢转了个方向，朝你。
lines.en: I turn slowly toward you.

lines.zh: 冰海里，我的长牙破开水面。
lines.en: In icy seas my tusk breaks the surface.

lines.zh: 血在冰下散开，我往深处退。
lines.en: Blood spreads under the ice; I retreat deeper.
I sink a little to avoid it.
Two tail strokes take me back.

lines.zh: 侧腹一疼，我往冰洞里钻。
lines.en: My flank stings; I dive into the ice hole.
I can still swim, only slower.
My blood is on the ice.
I turn my head to look.
A wound like this the sea will mend.
I surface again to breathe.
I have the scent of fish.
I surface and open my mouth.
Drop the fish into the ice hole.

lines.zh: 水从牙缝漏出去，鱼留下。
lines.en: Water leaks from my teeth; the fish stays.
Not enough. A few more.
I eat nothing but fish.

lines.zh: 冰海里，长牙是我的名字。
lines.en: In the frozen sea, the tusk is my name.

lines.zh: 你把鱼举高我就够不到。
lines.en: Hold it up high and I cannot reach.
That is fresh. Good.
When I finish I sink away.

lines.zh: 我把嘴张开等了一会儿。
lines.en: I hold my mouth open a while.
The fish in your hand is still moving.
Under the ice hole I raise my tusk.
The fish struggles in my mouth; I swallow slowly.

lines.zh: 你踩在冰上，我在下面顶了一下。
lines.en: You stood on the ice and I nudged it from below.
The ice rang under your weight.
I brushed the ice wall lightly.
The ice is thick. It will not break.
I back half a body and the water shifts.
Do not put your hand in the ice hole.
My body scrapes the ice edge.
At that the ice rocked.
I pass beneath your feet.
I rise until I nearly touch the ice.
There are a few more of us in this frozen sea.
We swim in a pod and break the ice together.
Their tusks are shorter than mine.
One of them is always beside me.

lines.zh: 两只长牙并排，破开冰面。
lines.en: Two tusks break the ice side by side.

lines.zh: 冰洞是我们一起磨出来的。
lines.en: We wore this breathing hole together.
It moves half a beat faster than I do.
If we scatter, we call.
The calls carry far through the water.
This sea is enough for the whole pod.
A fish floats at the ice hole.

lines.zh: 我用嘴唇一吸，它进了嘴。
lines.en: One suck of my lips and it's in.
Something is pinned under this ice.
I prod it with my tusk and cannot shift it.
That bright thing has sunk.
I dive and search a circle.
I hold a piece of ice in my mouth.

lines.zh: 这东西不能吃，我吐了，长牙还疼。
lines.en: This is not food; I spat it out, my tusk still aching.
I rarely take things from the bottom.
I push it up onto the ice.
A school of fish is moving.

lines.zh: 我从冰层下绕到你脚边。
lines.en: I circle beneath the ice to your feet.

lines.zh: 这个角度，它们看不见我。
lines.en: From here they cannot see me.

lines.zh: 我把嘴张开，等着鱼群过来。
lines.en: I open my mouth and wait for the fish.
The school is coming my way.
I hold still in the water.
It is dark under the ice. Good.
They are two body lengths away.
A length of my tusk can drop.
The current brings them to me.
I follow the school.
They shelter toward the ice wall.
It is too shallow there for me.
I circle outside.
They must come out eventually.

lines.zh: 冰面下很静，我等你走近。
lines.en: Under the ice it's quiet; I wait for you to near.
One slipped out.

lines.zh: 我贴着冰底，长牙先探出去。
lines.en: I skim the ice bottom, tusk first.
Water runs past my mouth.

lines.zh: 冰下的水一动，我转了过去。
lines.en: The water under the ice stirs; I turn.
I draw in several fish at once.
The water filters out past my gills.
I sweep the weed aside with my tusk.
They push into an ice crack.
One shove and a slab of ice splits.
The school scatters at once.
I chase the largest one.
It slips past my mouth.
I draw in again.
This time I have it.
I rise from under the ice.
My tusk breaks the thin ice.
Cold air hits my face.
This frozen sea is grey-blue.

lines.zh: 冰面破开，我浮上来换气。
lines.en: The ice breaks; I surface to breathe.
The rim of the ice hole is worn smooth.
A few fish are moving in the water.

lines.zh: 我从冰下浮上来，长牙破开薄冰。
lines.en: I surface from under the ice, my tusk through the thin crust.

lines.zh: 我的背把水面顶起一层。
lines.en: My back lifts the surface.
I swim for the deep of the frozen sea.

lines.zh: 火在水面上烧，我往下躲。
lines.en: Fire burned on the surface and I dropped away.

lines.zh: 我从冰台上滑下，摔进水里。
lines.en: I slid off an ice shelf into the water.
The hole has frozen over and I cannot break it.

lines.zh: 爆响把冰面掀开一大片。
lines.en: The blast tore open a wide sheet of ice.

lines.zh: 鱼叉扎进脂肪层，我甩尾。
lines.en: The harpoon sinks into my blubber; I thrash.
Strange light burns my hide underwater.

lines.zh: 冰下没有鱼，我越来越瘦。
lines.en: No fish under the ice and I grow thin.

lines.zh: 雷顺着长牙传下来，我沉下去。
lines.en: Lightning runs down my tusk; I dive.
The sea floor opened and I am falling.
